title: Conditional default states and tail capital
prompt: Losses are positive for losses and negative for gains. VaR at alpha is inf{x: P(loss<=x)>=alpha}; ES is the mean of the worst 1-alpha probability mass, taking only the necessary fraction of any boundary atom. Three mutually exclusive one-year states have the supplied physical probabilities, positive receivables in USD million, and counterparty default probabilities conditional on each state. Upon default the fund loses 60% of that state's receivable; there is no collateral, further exposure randomness, or discounting. A workout policy requires a dedicated buffer of at least the 95% ES of loss CONDITIONAL on this counterparty defaulting during the year. Its available buffer is 7 USD million. Report the unconditional default probability, state probabilities conditional on default, conditional loss VaR and ES at 95%, and whether the buffer is inadequate. Equality meets the requirement. This policy is a stated scenario requirement, not a regulatory capital formula.

outputs.name: default_probability
outputs.description: Unconditional probability of default during the year.

outputs.name: buffer_inadequate
outputs.description: True iff conditional 95% ES exceeds the 7-million buffer.
